source.stem: Decide whether the following statements are correct. Mark “√” for correct answers and “×” for wrong answers. (1) Objects that can move must be living things.

hinge.title: Decide whether an observed push or pull is a force and identify the interacting objects involved.

mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: The SI unit of force is pascal (Pa).

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: The isolated ball applies a force to itself.

intelligence.enrichment: A force is a push or pull on an object resulting from the object's interaction with another object; the SI unit of force is newton (N). interaction between two objects -> push or pull on an object -> force identified and measured in newtons The learner correctly applies this rule: A force is a push or pull on an object resulting from the object's interaction with another object; the SI unit of force is newton (N). Any visible movement is a force, so the interacting objects and the unit newton do not matter.
